producer_report.summary: The drain now passes over an item that fails twice on a flagged (not paused) line and runs the next item. Before, only a paused line was passed over. Root cause: after the last failed attempt, `Drain::attempts` asked only for a pause, and `Athena::line_pause` returns only pauses. A flagged line therefore ended the item as failed and stopped the batch. That is what happened to item 20261103-193428-df2m on 3 Nov. Changes: (1) `Athena::line_flag` and `Athena::flag_note` in scope_guard.rs. `line_flag` returns the stored flag only while the recomputed level still holds a flag, and ignores pause marks. (2) A defaulted `Steps::flagged` method, `ItemEnd::Flagged` and `Drain::flagged_reason` in drain.rs. The flag is asked only after the second failure and only when no pause was found, so a flagged line still gets both attempts. `finish` passes the item over with the flag reason (one `passed over` line, no failure counted). `RealSteps::flagged` is backed by `line_flag`. (3) Module docs, the `Stop::RepeatedFailure` doc, `Stop::meaning`, the `Drain::attempts` comment and the `athena drain --help` stop-reasons text now say that a flagged or paused line is passed over. (4) Tests: a Stub test for the new behavior with output assertions, an unflagged twin that still stops, a real-steps test, and a scope_guard unit test. Two existing tests that asserted the old flagged-line failure were updated: the real-steps stored-pause test, and `in_flight_row_goes_when_an_item_fails_twice`. (5) A CHANGELOG Fixed bullet. No pause file is written and no record changes.

open_issues: A flagged item that keeps failing is tried (two attempts) again on every later drain run, because the flag is consulted only after the second failure and nothing is written. That spends money each run. This matches the request and the plan's accepted risk.

The final `cargo test --locked` run returned with no error status but I could not read its saved output, so I saw no per-test totals for the whole workspace; the drain test binary had passed all other tests in the earlier run, and the one failure there was fixed.
mistakes: First draft of the new Stub test used JobLine fields that do not exist (outcome compared to an enum, a landed field); fixed after the compile error.
The unflagged twin first asserted no 'passed over' line at all and failed on b's 'run ended first' line; narrowed to a's line.
learnings: Any two rejections of an item on one line flag the line (T1 fires at attempt 2), so every fixture that fails an item twice with different criteria is now a flagged line and is passed over. The plan named only one such test (tests/drain.rs real-steps stored-pause test); in_flight_row_goes_when_an_item_fails_twice also encoded the old behavior and was updated.
JobLine in the drain report has string fields outcome ('passed', 'rejected', ...) and landing ('landed', ...); it has no landed boolean.

In the unflagged twin test, the batch's other queued item is still reported as 'plan b passed over: run ended first: repeated failure', so a test that checks for no passed-over line must match the item id.
